morphology_definitions.two_finger_tip_pinch_fraction: Hold-frame fraction with thumb tip plus exactly one active fingertip, no support contacts, and tip contacts dominating.
morphology_definitions.three_digit_clamp_fraction: Hold-frame fraction with thumb plus at least two active finger regions contacting the egg.
morphology_definitions.wrap_frame_fraction: Hold-frame fraction where support/non-tip/multi-digit enclosure evidence is present.
morphology_definitions.non_tip_contact_ratio: Mean share of hand contacts that are not fingertip proxy contacts.
